programme.title: The Zoo: Fawns Become Friends
programme.desc: Two sickly newborn fawns form an unbreakable bond while they are hand-reared by staff the leopard Khazo gets a surprise that enhances its life, and tensions run high as the reptile staff attempts to collect blood from Cuban crocs.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story: Running Free
programme.desc: Follow stray pups in Thailand through the first weeks of their dangerous lives. And in Kathmandu, dogs are worshiped and dressed with garlands for the Tihar festival.

programme.title: I Was Prey: Invisible Assassin
programme.desc: Diver Tim Saxon films underwater at the Great Barrier Reef and gets stung by an Irukandji jellyfish, one of the world's most venomous animals a grizzly bear attacks forester George Knoll in the remote Great Bear Rainforest.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Crocodile Love Story
programme.desc: It's moving day for Acco, the zoo's biggest crocodile all goes to plan until his mate Cassie goes into hiding the team races to reunite the bonded pair in their new enclosure the rescue unit fights to save a flying fox entangled in barbed wire.

programme.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Repeat Offender
programme.desc: Tigger, a repeat offender, has done it again and Shaun must battle high winds this time to get him down Tom comes face to face with a friendly Fritter, who turns hostile on a dime.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R.: The Heart of the Conflict
programme.desc: Investigating a string of murdered lions, Ivan gets to the very heart of an ancient conflict between humans and lions. The outcome will test Ivan's own core values about cultural perspective and conservation.

programme.title: Crikey! It's Shark Week
programme.desc: Robert Irwin comes face to face with a great white shark for the first time with shark conservationists Paul de Gelder and Madison Stewart following in his father's footsteps, he will get as close as possible to these incredible creatures.

programme.title: The Zoo: A New Beginning
programme.desc: Max the Camel faces new challenges as he ages the Zoo prepares to give an injured turkey vulture a permanent home, but after healing, there may be a change of plan Willow the Red Panda gives birth to two baby cubs.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story: Survival of the Friendliest
programme.desc: A look at how dogs have evolved from wild predators to friendly pets features parts of the world where dogs are spoiled as much as children.
